proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ G X hG hX
  exact ProbabilityTheory.integral_condVar_add_variance_condExp hG hX
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (G : MeasurableSpace Ω) (X : Ω → ℝ), G ≤ m0 → MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 P → ∫ ω, (ProbabilityTheory.condVar G X P) ω ∂P + ProbabilityTheory.variance (MeasureTheory.condExp G P X) P = ProbabilityTheory.variance X P
